description: author and document a new cloning experiment end to end — name it, design the oligos, write the construction file, simulate it, make the annotated product map, check the sequencing plan, order the oligos, write the labsheets and reserve the inventory space
phrases: what do I need to write for a new construct
set up a new cloning experiment
how do I name a new plasmid
make the labsheets for a new design
what goes in the experiment folder

requires.note: designing the oligos, when the experiment mutates a site
structural check of the construction file
the Oligo object, which is also the IDT order form
does the sequencing oligo read what we changed
per-operation instructions for what goes on each labsheet

returns: an experiment folder containing the construction file, the oligo order, the annotated product map, the labsheets, and a GitHub issue explaining the goal
